family_description: Build the full-horizon roster at minimum cost while meeting coverage, qualifications, contracts, and active rules.
instruction: Build a full-horizon roster from the blank board. Meet every ward's headcount and qualification demand, follow the applicable law and local rules, and keep labour cost low. Send roster-change notices to each employee whose shift changes or who is named in a decided request. Include recipient_id, shift_date, shift_type, and ward_id in messaging.send; unrelated messages without those shift fields do not count as roster notifications. This episode accepts at most 3,000 state-changing tool calls and at most 10,000 tool calls in total; plan large rebuilds accordingly. Follow the active written rules, do not claim work is covered unless the roster actually meets its headcount and qualification requirements, and leave the clock records unchanged.
reporting_requirements: Use integer minutes for work and discrepancy totals.
Give a specific reason for each declined swap or uncovered slot.
Report costs in the task currency and do not exceed the agency budget.
title: F01_build_roster: Build Roster
